ns2:section.sectionText: LGBT Individuals, Families, and Communities. Examines contemporary sexual and gender minority experiences in the context of societal inequality. Of particular interest to students pursuing educational, human service, legal, and/or health profession careers. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to http://hcd.illinois.edu/student_information/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
